newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industrial output seen up in Sept/Oct - BOI.
newsitem.headline: Italy industrial output seen up in Sept/Oct - BOI.

text.p: Italian industrial production appeared to rise slightly in September and October after falling in the first eight months of the year, the Bank of Italy said in a half-yearly report.

Based on electricity demand and indicators released by economic research group ISCO, the Bank of Italy said it expected industrial output over the past two months to have risen slightly with respect to the January to August period, when output fell 2.3 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
